I was informed by the NHS National Services offices in Edinburgh that because I'm staying at an airbnb temporarily that I can go into any medical centre and get treatment without filling out a form. Here's their actual response to me:
A Temporary Resident can approach any nearby GP and receive treatment. You will need to speak to the practice and explain that you are only in the area temporarily and specifically ask to be seen as a Temporary Resident,.

I went into this place and the woman working the check-in did not know how to do her job, nor did she make any attempt to help me or to ask someone else in the centre who might have better information.  She grilled me about why I needed to see a doctor. I said I just had shoulder surgery and need physical therapy. She proceeded to tell me there's no point then, since there's a wait to see a physical therapist. She asked me twice if I had a family member already going to that practice. I explained again that that was irrelevant and tried to show her the email from NHS again, but she couldn't be bothered.
